author: JKawesome
body:
Hey guys, so after thinking for a while for a map idea, I decided to build a sequel to Ciutat, but this time for Nebula DTM. You might recognize the middle from the original Ciutat in Nexus, because that stayed pretty much the same. I changed the rest of the buildings around, and you spawn in the smaller building this time. There are two monuments, one in each skyscraper.

Credit goes to:
- Jozzeh for doing the YML
- Evocal for building the middle place from Ciutat Nexus
- xJLx888x (my brother) for helping with one of the skyscrapers

Enjoy!











View the rest of the album here: http://imgur.com/a/Od80Z
YAML: Will be posted once complete
Map download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/0pa83br3cy18xmj/CiutatDTM.zip

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Oh boy. Thats a lot of clay heh.

Looking at this image (http://i.imgur.com/oHlwJXZ.png) the stone and ores pillar is very blocky and chunky. Round off the edges and have something support it so its not just floating.

Then from this image (http://i.imgur.com/B8Q7sZ4.png) the map seems very flat. The house could use more details but mostly I really hate the floot. Its very flat and does not provide any cover.

This image (http://i.imgur.com/7gxYkfT.jpg) is a nice park on the map you made. I really like the benches and the fences but again, it being so flat all around ruins it.

The map could use more buildings and could be a bit different when it comes to height limit. Changing the double stone slabs into regular slabs and moving them one block higher could already do quite a lot for your map.
